knight_hp_1.label: +1 HP
knight_hp_1.description: Edwin gains 1 maximum HP and 1 current HP when next deployed.

knight_hp_2.label: +2 HP
knight_hp_2.description: Edwin gains 2 maximum HP and 2 current HP when next deployed.

knight_shield_damage_1.label: +1 shield damage
knight_shield_damage_1.description: Reflected damage and Shield Throw each deal 1 more damage.

knight_hp_5.label: +5 HP
knight_hp_5.description: Edwin gains 5 maximum HP and 5 current HP when next deployed.

knight_dig_in.label: Dig In
knight_dig_in.description: While guarding, reverse an enemy pull against Edwin and pull the enemy instead.

knight_shield_throw.label: Shield Throw
knight_shield_throw.description: Gain a range-3 attack for 3 damage. Retrieve the shield before guarding or throwing again. Advance heads toward the shield while it is away.

knight_shield_damage_3.label: +3 shield damage
knight_shield_damage_3.description: Reflected damage and Shield Throw each deal 3 more damage.

knight_wide_guard.label: Wide Guard
knight_wide_guard.description: Guard covers one additional tile of range.

healer_hp_1.label: +1 HP
healer_hp_1.description: Marta gains 1 maximum HP and 1 current HP when next deployed.

healer_hp_2.label: +2 HP
healer_hp_2.description: Marta gains 2 maximum HP and 2 current HP when next deployed.

healer_long_staff.label: Long Staff
healer_long_staff.description: Bonk can reach one tile farther.

healer_strong_swing.label: Strong Swing
healer_strong_swing.description: Bonk also strikes every other opponent within range.

healer_me_or_you.label: Me or You
healer_me_or_you.description: If hurt, Marta receives the full heal. Otherwise split it evenly among the other living deployed heroes, including those at full HP. Extra points go in party order; unused healing is lost.

wizard_spare_robes.label: Spare Robes
wizard_spare_robes.description: Pip gains 1 maximum HP and 1 current HP when next deployed.

wizard_more_powder.label: More Powder
wizard_more_powder.description: Blast deals 1 more damage, whoever or whatever it hits.

wizard_padded_landing.label: Padded Landing
wizard_padded_landing.description: Pull recoil deals 1 less damage, to a minimum of zero. Pip still falls over.

wizard_demolition_practice.label: Demolition Practice
wizard_demolition_practice.description: Blast deals 2 more damage against obstacles.

wizard_duck.label: Duck!
wizard_duck.description: An ally hit by Blast takes the damage but stays on their feet.

wizard_braced_casting.label: Braced Casting
wizard_braced_casting.description: Pip stays standing if Pull recoil ends against the board edge or impassable terrain directly behind them.

wizard_parting_gift.label: Parting Gift
wizard_parting_gift.description: Blast pushes its surviving primary target one tile away if that tile is open.

wizard_conductive_personality.label: Conductive Personality
wizard_conductive_personality.description: Blast jumps to the nearest other damageable target, even Pip, for half damage rounded up. The bolt has no other effects.

rogue_thick_coat.label: Thick Coat
rogue_thick_coat.description: Tess gains 1 maximum HP and 1 current HP when next deployed.

rogue_cheap_shot.label: Cheap Shot
rogue_cheap_shot.description: A successful Wasn't Me redirect adds 1 damage to the victim. An attack that isn't redirected gains nothing.

rogue_exit_strategy.label: Exit Strategy
rogue_exit_strategy.description: Retreat can take a second step if it increases distance from the nearest opponent. Direct Move stays one tile.

rogue_borrowed_courage.label: Borrowed Courage
rogue_borrowed_courage.description: After swapping with an ally, reduce the next hit on that ally before Tess's next turn by 1.

rogue_pass_the_buck.label: Pass the Buck
rogue_pass_the_buck.description: Confusing Dodge passes a swap partner's unused Wasn't Me mark to another enemy adjacent to their landing tile, if one exists.

rogue_pocket_sand.label: Pocket Sand
rogue_pocket_sand.description: An enemy swapped by Confusing Dodge cannot move on its next turn, but can still attack.

rogue_long_finger.label: Long Finger
rogue_long_finger.description: A marked attacker without an adjacent alternate victim can blame someone two tiles away. Tess still cannot choose the victim.

rogue_body_double.label: Body Double
rogue_body_double.description: After Dodge, the first attack aimed at Tess before their next turn hits their living swap partner instead, friend or foe.

bard_road_legs.label: Road Legs
bard_road_legs.description: Crispin gains 1 maximum HP and 1 current HP when next deployed.

bard_buskers_hat.label: Busker's Hat
bard_buskers_hat.description: If Melody has no eligible listener, heal Crispin for 1. This still uses the action.

bard_front_row_seats.label: Front Row Seats
bard_front_row_seats.description: Sonnet draws from the two opponents with the fewest HP, including ties at the cutoff. If only one remains, it hits that one.

bard_laughing_fit.label: Laughing Fit
bard_laughing_fit.description: After an opponent loses a turn to laughter, the next hit before their next activation deals 2 more damage.

bard_heckler.label: Heckler
bard_heckler.description: An opponent who survives Sonnet directs their next attack at Crispin if Crispin is a legal target.

bard_house_lights.label: House Lights
bard_house_lights.description: Gain Take the Stage as a standing order and direct action. One random eligible opponent and every opponent adjacent to it take the current Sonnet damage.

necromancer_spare_ribs.label: Spare Ribs
necromancer_spare_ribs.description: Skeletons start with 1 more maximum and current HP.

necromancer_good_soil.label: Good Soil
necromancer_good_soil.description: Zombies start with 1 more HP after halving the corpse's maximum HP and rounding up.

necromancer_heavy_bouquet.label: Heavy Bouquet
necromancer_heavy_bouquet.description: Zombies' Offer Flower deals 1 more damage.

necromancer_broad_wave.label: Broad Wave
necromancer_broad_wave.description: Skeletons' Wave also hits diagonal neighbors, friend or foe.

necromancer_long_stemmed.label: Long-Stemmed
necromancer_long_stemmed.description: Offer Flower has 1 more tile of range, including the distance zombies try to reach.

necromancer_warm_welcome.label: Warm Welcome
necromancer_warm_welcome.description: Say Hello makes the recipient back away up to two tiles, stopping at the first obstruction.

necromancer_say_hello_to_that_one.label: Say Hello to That One
necromancer_say_hello_to_that_one.description: Gain a direct action to nominate an opponent for both undead to pursue until it falls or is replaced. They still choose their own greetings.

necromancer_wake_reception.label: Wake Reception
necromancer_wake_reception.description: Once per mission, a fallen raised zombie becomes a skeleton if the skeleton slot is empty. It uses the current skeleton starting HP and first acts next round.

alchemist_padded_apron.label: Padded Apron
alchemist_padded_apron.description: Gain 1 maximum HP without changing how much HP is missing.

alchemist_concentrate.label: Concentrate
alchemist_concentrate.description: Acid deals 1 more damage to its target.

alchemist_long_ladle.label: Long Ladle
alchemist_long_ladle.description: Healing Potion reaches one tile farther. Follow still stops beside the nearest ally.

alchemist_spare_vial.label: Spare Vial
alchemist_spare_vial.description: Gain Plain Tonic: a range-1 heal for 1 with no reaction. Potion upgrades do not affect it.

alchemist_brittle_glass.label: Brittle Glass
alchemist_brittle_glass.description: Acid and Etching Paste splash for 1 damage around the recipient, friends included. Their fitted forms instead heal adjacent friends for 1. Only the chosen recipient gets a reaction.

alchemist_keep_the_culture.label: Keep the Culture
alchemist_keep_the_culture.description: Save the recipe and reaction from your last Healing Potion, Acid, or Etching Paste. Repeat Batch uses both on another legal recipient, then empties the bottle. Bottles do not carry between missions.

smith_leather_apron.label: Leather Apron
smith_leather_apron.description: Gain 1 maximum HP without changing how much HP is missing.

smith_heavier_hammer.label: Heavier Hammer
smith_heavier_hammer.description: Hammer Time deals 1 more damage. Other offenses are unchanged.

smith_follow_through.label: Follow Through
smith_follow_through.description: When Hammer Time defeats its target, step onto its tile if you survive the defeat effects and can still enter it.

smith_reinforced_rivets.label: Reinforced Rivets
smith_reinforced_rivets.description: Each new fitting reduces the wearer's next hit by 1 per copy. Unused protection expires with the fitting.

smith_fine_adjustment.label: Fine Adjustment
smith_fine_adjustment.description: Improve the performed alternate: add 1 to its primary amount, or grant Steady Hands to reduce the wearer's next hit by 1 before their next turn. Does not boost ordinary fallback or stack with Inspiration.

smith_quick_release.label: Quick Release
smith_quick_release.description: Give the fitted wearer a direct command to remove their fitting and then step one tile. Ordinary Move keeps the fitting.

smith_double_shift.label: Double Shift
smith_double_shift.description: Keep fittings on two different teammates at once. Each spends its own fitting; standing Try This still considers only the nearest teammate.

smith_quick_release.label: Quick Release
smith_quick_release.help: Remove your fitting, then step to an open neighboring tile. Ordinary Move keeps the fitting.

alchemist_plain_tonic.label: Plain Tonic
alchemist_plain_tonic.help: Heal yourself or a friendly character within one tile for 1 HP, without a reaction.

alchemist_repeat_batch.label: Repeat Batch
alchemist_repeat_batch.help: Repeat the bottled recipe and exact reaction on another legal recipient; empties the bottle.

knight_shield_throw.label: Shield Throw
knight_shield_throw.help: Deal 3 damage to an enemy or obstacle up to three tiles away. Advance heads toward the thrown shield; retrieve it to guard or throw again.

bard_take_the_stage.label: Take the Stage
bard_take_the_stage.help: Sing Healing Sonnet to one random eligible opponent and every opponent next to them.

direct.help: Sing Healing Sonnet to a chosen eligible opponent and every opponent next to them.

necromancer_say_hello_to_that_one.label: Say Hello to That One
necromancer_say_hello_to_that_one.help: Nominate a living opponent for your undead to pursue. They still choose their own greetings.
